Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-D-elisinhinthra-2022-07-31-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V0-D-elisinhinthra-2022-07-05.png]], 5 July 2022) → [[File:V0-D-elisinhinthra-2022-07-31-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V0-D-elisinhinthra.gif]], 31 July 2022). * '''Original''' ([[Elis In Hinthra]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-elisinhinthra022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/elisinhinthra.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/elisinhinthra.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•''Virago''”. Text: “May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Elis, who provides ability of 2. Once per game, may deploy a smuggler aboard from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While at opponent's system, adds one [Light Side]. Immune to attrition <5.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Elis In Hinthra (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 22 June 2021<ref name="img-elisinhinthra30816d1">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/elisinhinthra.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/30816d1eceffdd0a07a5af277fcbcbc9fc96f665 commit 30816d1] (22 June 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/elisinhinthra.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
